_comment: Voyager endpoint identifiers, kept in config rather than code so they can be
refreshed from a new browser capture without a redeploy.
Decoration IDs carry a version suffix (-101). LinkedIn bumps these when a
projection changes; a stale one usually 400s. `profileFallbacks` is tried in
order, so adding a newly captured version at the front is the whole fix.
Refresh with: npm run har -- captures/your.har
